100 Years Ago Today, This is What Was Happening ...

On August 9, 1926, the United States celebrated the successful launch of the first transatlantic commercial flight, marking a significant milestone in aviation history. Meanwhile, political tensions escalated in Europe as France and Germany engaged in heated discussions over reparations, further straining post-World War I relations. In South America, Chile faced a devastating earthquake, prompting international aid offers in response to the disaster's impact.
